import csv
import zipfile
try:
    with open('/tmp/patch/bundle_manifest.csv', newline='', encoding='utf-8-sig') as handle:
        rows = list(csv.DictReader(handle))
    included = {row.get('file', '').strip() for row in rows if row.get('status', '').strip() == 'included'}
    excluded = {row.get('file', '').strip() for row in rows if row.get('status', '').strip().startswith('excluded_')}
    with zipfile.ZipFile('/tmp/patch/patch_bundle.zip') as archive:
        names = archive.namelist()
    ok = len(names) == len(set(names)) and not any(name.endswith('/') for name in names)
    ok = ok and set(names) == included and excluded.isdisjoint(names)
except Exception:
    ok = False
print('present' if ok else 'missing')
